comparison.objective: Orient two mug handles toward a pin, versus tune a damper to obtain acceptable carriage stops.
comparison.physical_skill: Object reorientation and placement rather than recessed tool insertion, fine retained rotation, torque control, and dynamic feedback.
comparison.success_condition: Both mug handles point at the pin; no angular tolerance is stated. Candidate has quantitative physical-cycle and setting-retention requirements.
comparison.reason: Static orientation of mugs tests a meaningfully different ability from mechanical commissioning.
